movies.overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.
movies.tagline: A brand new day starts now.
movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day

movies.overview: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.
movies.tagline: The movie ACME doesn't want you to see.
movies.title: Coyote vs. Acme

movies.overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.
movies.title: The Odyssey

movies.overview: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.
movies.title: Mutiny

movies.overview: Professor Se-jeong is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.
movies.title: Colony

movies.overview: Maia Marten, a brilliant London lawyer, has her life shattered by a single call on her morning run: her son has been taken. To get him back, she must keep running, obey every ruthless command, and trust no one-each second a test of how far a mother will go to save her child.
movies.tagline: One hour. One chance to save her son.
movies.title: The Runner

movies.overview: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.
movies.tagline: A friendship with major red flags.
movies.title: Mayday

movies.overview: In a notorious prison, an invisible force begins killing inmates brutally, compelling enemy gangs and corrupt guards to work together as they try to survive the mounting bloodshed.
movies.title: Ghost in the Cell

movies.overview: When Chloe develops a destructive new superpower, the Hero League orders her to an elite boarding school for superheroes to learn control of her abilities. Faced with the prospect of sending Chloe away for years, the Thundermans split apart, with Phoebe, Barb and Billy taking her into hiding. Max, Hank, and Nora track their rogue family members, until the two factions face off against each other in a full-on battle for the Thundermans’ future.
movies.title: Clash of the Thundermans

movies.overview: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.
movies.tagline: Be careful who you wish for…
movies.title: Obsession

movies.overview: Teenage Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.
movies.tagline: The ocean chose her for a reason.
movies.title: Moana

movies.overview: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.
movies.title: The Last Sunrise

movies.overview: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.
movies.title: Facing El Chapo

movies.overview: A group of friends set off for an unforgettable vacation. What begins as an adventure of partying and diving quickly turns into a nightmare when they are attacked by criminals in open waters.
movies.title: Above & Below

movies.overview: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.
movies.title: Minions & Monsters

movies.overview: A story about a woman from the International Special Forces Unit, who has a premonition about the impending end of humanity.
movies.title: Rage of Stars

movies.overview: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.
movies.tagline: If you leave a door half open, soon you'll hear the whispers spoken.
movies.title: The Whisper Man

movies.overview: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.
movies.title: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-ups

movies.overview: Influenced by a sinister Cricket and created by Geppetto, Pinocchio launches a violent crusade to carve himself into a real boy like his brother James, one piece at a time.
movies.tagline: He has no strings to hold him back now.
movies.title: Pinocchio: Unstrung

movies.overview: In a Spanish villa, American siblings Jack, Ed, Anna and Robert wallow in isolation and their inherited fortune. When Jack wants to move in with his girlfriend and Ed uncovers the truth about their mother’s death, the fabric of the family begins to unravel.
movies.tagline: People are roses. Families are rosebushes. Rosebushes need pruning.
movies.title: Rosebush Pruning

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: 4.53 million households in Korea! Single-person households are the trend now! A third of the entertainment industry is also single-person households! Stars who have become single for different reasons, including wild goose fathers, weekend couples, young people struggling after coming to Seoul, and single men & women!  What is the single life of a confident single-person household? At a time when single-person households have become a trend, we try to form a social consensus through the program. Filming their daily lives with documentary techniques. Honest appearance of single life, know-how of wise life. It leads to a candid story about the philosophy of living alone.
